mapper.sql: id, resource_type, event_type, room_id, seat_id, after_snapshot, order_policy, effective_at, operator_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_status_event (resource_type, event_type, room_id, seat_id, after_snapshot, order_policy, effective_at, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{resourceType}, #{eventType}, #{roomId}, #{seatId}, #{afterSnapshot}, #{orderPolicy}, #{effectiveAt}, #{operatorId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resource_status_event WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY effective_at, id
SELECT FROM resource_status_event WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} ORDER BY effective_at, id
